meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你排查容器化代理运行问题。它会检查日志、数据库和挂载点，找出容器启动失败、认证错误或消息丢失的原因。
howto.when: 当容器代理不工作、启动失败、出现认证问题，或你想了解容器系统如何运作时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看为什么容器代理没有回复消息。
检查一下是否有重复的 NanoClaw 服务实例在运行。
say.note: Claude 会运行 ps aux 命令并分析结果。

say.text: 重启 agent group 的容器并重建镜像。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help debug containerized agent execution issues. It checks logs, databases, and mounts to identify reasons for container failures, authentication problems, or lost messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when container agents are not working, fail to start, have authentication issues, or when you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: Check why the container agent is not replying.
say_en.note: Claude inspects inbound.db and outbound.db message flow.

say_en.text: Check for duplicate NanoClaw service instances.
say_en.note: Claude runs ps aux and analyzes the output.

say_en.text: Restart the agent group container and rebuild the image.
